glosses: footprint (impression of the foot in a soft substance)
fingerprint (unique natural pattern of ridges on the tips of the fingers; marks left by these)

examples.text: Tom se puso guantes de goma para no dejar huella.
examples.en: Tom put on some rubber gloves so he wouldn't leave fingerprints.

examples.text: El cazador siguió las huellas del oso.
examples.en: The hunter followed the bear's tracks.

examples.text: Las compañías productoras de electricidad están buscando reducir su huella de carbono.
examples.en: Electric power companies are seeking to reduce their use of coal.
